assertion: The New York Police Department said on 9 November that 230 murders were recorded between 1 January and 31 October, below the previous first-ten-months record of 244, set in 2017.
sql: SELECT year, SUM(CASE WHEN month<=10 THEN actual_murder ELSE 0 END) FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE ori='NY03030' GROUP BY year
independent_value: NYPD 9 Nov 2026 release: 230 murders, previous record low 244 in 2017

assertion: The total was 15.7% lower than the 273 murders recorded during the same period in 2025.
There were 536 shooting incidents, down 10.4% from 598 in the same period last year, and 649 shooting victims, a 13% fall from 746.
Major crime declined 6.5% year on year, from 102,726 incidents to 96,059. October major crime fell 8.6% compared with October 2025.
The department reported 391 murders in 2023 and 377 in 2024. Its 2025 year-end announcement subsequently used 382 as the 2024 comparison figure, reporting 305 murders that year, a 20.2% decline.
warehouse_value: FBI Return A annual murders (lagging NYPD): 2022 = 438, 2023 = 397, 2024 = 325, same downward direction
independent_value: NYPD 6 Jan 2026 release: 305 vs 382, -20.2%; Jan 2025 release: 377 in 2024, 14 fewer than 2023

assertion: Detectives carried out 26 gang-related takedowns in 2026 and seized more than 4,500 illegal guns, the department said.
independent_value: NYPD release: 26 gang-related takedowns; 4,500+ illegal guns seized

assertion: Transit crime rose 2.2% in the first ten months, while shooting incidents increased 4.4% and shooting victims rose 5.8% in October year on year.
independent_value: NYPD: transit 1,825 vs 1,786 (+2.2%); October shootings 47 vs 45 (+4.4%), victims 55 vs 52 (+5.8%)

assertion: Mamdani took office on 1 January, meaning the figures cover his first ten months as mayor.
independent_value: NYPD 6 Jan 2026 release quotes Mayor Zohran Mamdani; the 9 Nov release window is 1 Jan-31 Oct 2026

assertion: They establish that murders fell in his first ten months, not that any single policy or administration was responsible.
source_finding: NYPD releases report counts only; year-end series shows murders falling 2023-2025 before Mamdani took office.
independent_value: NYPD counts are descriptive and the decline predates January 2026

assertion: Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch attributed the results to the NYPD's data-driven strategy, including identifying drivers of violence, removing illegal guns and targeting gangs.
speaker: Jessica Tisch
source_finding: The release counts takedowns and gun seizures (activity) but contains no analysis isolating their effect on murders.
reason: The statement was made (NYPD release and NY1 both quote it), but no evidence found tests the causal link between the strategy and the murder decline.
measure: NYPD murders New York City crime
